question: Which of the following ancient site is NOT situated in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mehrgarh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mehrgarh** is not situated in India but in present-day **Pakistan.**
 
• **Hunsgi** is an ancient site located in the state of **Karnataka**, India, known for its** Paleolithic and Neolithic **stone tools and artifacts.
 
• **Hallur **is an archaeological site located in the state of **Karnataka, India**, known for its **megalithic** burials and artifacts from the Iron Age.
 
• **Inamgaon **is an ancient site located in the state of **Maharashtra, **India, known for its** Chalcolithic and Bronze Age **settlements and artifacts.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mehrgarh** is an archaeological site located in the **Balochistan province of Pakistan**, known for its Neolithic and Bronze Age settlements and artifacts.
 
• The site was discovered in **1974 **and is considered one of the most **important archaeological sites** in South Asia for understanding the early human settlements and the development of **agriculture and civilization.**
 
• Mehrgarh was inhabited from around **7000 BCE to 2000 BCE** and is known for its advanced **metallurgy, pottery, and textile industries.**
 
• The site has also yielded evidence of early domestication of animals such as **sheep, goats, and cattle, and the cultivation of crops such as wheat, barley, and lentils.**
